title: Reader sign-in on Shipped fails after the code exchange (sign_in_error unknown)
description:
Ryan, 2026-10-24 around 16:30 UTC: the public reader Sign in on https://shipped.anth.us shows 'Sign-in did not complete. Try again.'

Diagnosis so far (read-only):
- Sign-in start works. The 303 goes to Cognito (pool us-east-1_t5Rk1NdU7, client 4fefkac5sepfm8cbdogeo898lv) and sets the pending cookie.
- The cookie survives the round trip: a wrong-state probe gives state_mismatch.
- The code exchange is reached: a bogus code gives code_exchange_failed.
- The Prospectus resource policy, registration and challenge calls all work.
- Nothing changed in the callback code between 5.31.0 and 5.33.1.
- The failure is therefore after the code exchange. Likely nonce_mismatch or token_pair_mismatch, or a rejection before the Prospectus resolve Lambda runs.
- Every named failure branch in handleProspectusSignInCallback (lib/prospectus-sign-in-routes.ts) is silent, so the logs can't tell.

Next:
(1) An observability PR: log a structured prospectus_sign_in_failed line for every branch, and show the code in the reader UI (in progress).
(2) After release and the Shipped bump, Ryan retries and reports the shown code; or, before that, he reads the callback response's Location header (?sign_in_error=CODE) in DevTools.
(3) Fix the root cause. If it's on the Prospectus side, hand the evidence to the Prospectus session.

Blocks: the Shipped reader stories b3b934, 378fcc, d02e82 and b35fa2 (end-to-end sign-in, vote, rate, used-it, submit, comment).

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-24: root cause was on the Papyrus side. Prospectus issues a signed challengeToken and stores nothing; Papyrus sent only challengeId, so resolve returned 401 challenge_invalid. Fixed in #683 (released 5.37.0, Shipped deployed on 5.37.0+). No sign-in attempt has been logged since. Waiting on: Ryan's retry on shipped.anth.us. If it fails, the log now carries prospectusMessage.
